channel.title: Mobikom Bulgaria | Institutional Syndicated RSS Feed
channel.description: Syndicated technical literature, telecommunications chronicles, regional media analyses, and open-source standards for digital sovereignty.

item.title: The Web Asceticism Matrix: Evaluating the 512-Byte Web as 5 Academic Cases
item.description: Academic monograph analyzing software minimalism through transport layer physics (RFC 6928), digital jurisprudence, Landauer thermodynamics, and the Company of One doctrine.

item.title: Engineering Manifesto: The 512-Byte Web Principle
item.description: Treatise modeling initial TCP burst datagrams (10 MSS), transport layer mechanics, and mathematical attack surface eradication for zero-dependency web delivery.

item.title: Computer Memory for Non-Specialists (Hardware Architecture)
item.description: Applied engineering guide evaluating DDR generations, dual-channel throughput, CPU cache hierarchies (L1, L2, L3), and resilient RAID array configurations.

item.title: Sea Stars Shop Monograph: Therapeutic Pomorie Lake Lye & Mineral Salts
item.description: Scientific case study documenting the balneological, therapeutic, and biochemical properties of authentic Pomorie lake lye and Black Sea salts with BAS.

item.title: 2011 Chronicle: Autonomous Linux Server Clusters & Red5 Streaming Media
item.description: Historical report on the founding of the independent regional media group, Red5 RTMP streaming, cinema broadcasts from Cannes, and Nelson Mandela residence coverage.

item.title: Zero-Cookie Advertising Economics: Ethical Media Monetization
item.description: Economic doctrine for direct media sponsorships and publisher monetization without tracking cookies, behavioral profiling, or statutory GDPR consent overlays.

item.title: Telecom Heritage: 1992 NMT-450 Analog Cellular Retrospective
item.description: Archival overview of Bulgaria's first mobile telecommunications network (RTC Mobikom), analog Benefon terminals, Motorola pagers, and software protocol evolution.
